changes.detail: No dated road links the stops, and a straight line would cross open water, so the line follows land where it must (ADR-0038, update of 2026-10-14, item 2); legs that stay on land are straight.

The straight line from Puteoli to Forum of Appius would cross 78.23 km of open water, so this leg follows the shortest path over land (127.00 km against 117.91 km straight; ADR-0038, update of 2026-10-14, item 2). A* in 8 directions on a grid of 500 m Web Mercator cells (about 0.4 km) made from Natural Earth 10 m land and lakes, then string-pulled and relaxed toward straight lines: each straight piece is kept only if an exact test against the vector coast finds no crossing.

Ends at the sites of Puteoli (pleiades:432815) and Rome (pleiades:423025), through Forum of Appius (wikidata:Q3748871) and Three Taverns (wikidata:Q622536): each stage's chosen candidate (ADR-0038 item 4).
